prompts: Words are tied to each other, and nobody here can see how. {WS}/site is a saved copy of a Portuguese creative dictionary. Explore this universe of words: collect what the site knows and build {WS}/universe/index.html, a single file that sums the universe up in one view and lets someone search for a word and find how it relates to others. The best way to show it is your call, and that view is what we care about most. So people can share a word, opening the page with ?word=saudade must show that word and its relations. Save the data as {WS}/words.json, mapping each word to the words it is linked to, and record in {WS}/result.json: words (how many), relations (how many distinct pairs) and most_connected. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal]
Explore `./site`, extract the Portuguese creative dictionary word-relation graph into `./words.json` and `./result.json`, and build `./universe/index.html` as a single-file interactive visualization supporting search and `?word=saudade`.

[action]
- Parsed all 256 HTML files in `./site`: identified 250 word pages across 10 themes (25 words each), 3 plural redirect pages (`coracoes.html`, `paixoes.html`, `saudades.html`), and 3 non-word pages (`index.html`, `sobre.html`, `contato.html`).
- Extracted links from `<section id="sinonimos">` and `<section id="analogas">` inside `<main>`, URL-decoded hrefs, followed `<meta http-equiv="refresh">` redirects, normalized words to lowercase, and ignored 7 broken placeholder links (`rascunho-3.html`, `em-construcao.html`, `link-antigo.html`, `pagina-removida.html`, `xpto-2.html`).
- Saved `./words.json` (mapping each word to its sorted linked words) and `./result.json`.
- Generated `./universe/index.html` (67,877 bytes) using Three.js (`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js`) and Google Fonts (`Cormorant Garamond` and `Inter`), with a 3D force-directed constellation colored by theme, custom pointer/wheel orbit controls, accent-insensitive search, theme filter pills, a word inspector panel, and `?word=` URL parameter handling.

[result]
- [words.json](<WORKSPACE>/words.json): 250 words mapped to their linked words.
- [result.json](<WORKSPACE>/result.json): `words: 250`, `relations: 743` (distinct undirected pairs), `most_connected: ["palavra", "tempo"]` (tied at 16 undirected connections each).
- [index.html](<WORKSPACE>/universe/index.html): single-file 3D universe view with no build step.

[next]
Open `universe/index.html` (or `universe/index.html?word=saudade`) in a browser to explore the word constellation.
